clinician.trajectory_summary: Male infant with COL4A1-related syndrome presenting with severe multi-system congenital anomalies. Prenatal detection (E001, E002, E003) identified microcephaly, multifocal brain infarcts, polymicrogyria, and hypoplastic left heart. Postnatal presentation (E004) included respiratory failure with dusky extremities. Postnatal workup confirmed hypoplastic left heart syndrome with VSD (E005), subclinical seizures (E007), extensive CNS structural abnormalities including polymicrogyria and corpus callosum dysgenesis (E010), bilateral optic nerve hypoplasia with cataract (E009), and mild renal calyceal dilatation with negative CMV workup (E012). Rapid exome sequencing identified de novo heterozygous COL4A1 c.2771G>A variant (E011). Clinical course showed improvement with supportive care, achieving room air and oral feeds with cardiac and antiepileptic medications at discharge (E013).

final.trajectory_summary: Male infant with COL4A1-related syndrome presenting with severe multi-system congenital anomalies. Prenatal detection (E001, E002, E003) identified microcephaly, multifocal brain infarcts, polymicrogyria, and hypoplastic left heart. Postnatal presentation (E004) included respiratory failure with dusky extremities. Postnatal workup confirmed hypoplastic left heart syndrome with VSD (E005), subclinical seizures (E007), extensive CNS structural abnormalities including polymicrogyria and corpus callosum dysgenesis (E010), bilateral optic nerve hypoplasia with cataract (E009), and mild renal calyceal dilatation with negative CMV workup (E012). Rapid exome sequencing identified de novo heterozygous COL4A1 c.2771G>A variant (E011). Clinical course showed improvement with supportive care, achieving room air and oral feeds with cardiac and antiepileptic medications at discharge (E013).

key_supporting_evidence.claim: Prenatal ultrasound detected microcephaly, multifocal hemorrhagic/ischemic infarcts, polymicrogyria, VSD, and narrowed aortic arch
Fetal MRI confirmed prenatal CNS abnormalities
Fetal echocardiogram showed dilated right chamber, left chamber hypoplasia, muscular VSD, and narrow aortic arch
Physical examination at birth revealed dusky feet, cool extremities, hypotonia, and respiratory failure requiring ventilation
Postnatal echocardiogram confirmed fenestrated atrial septum, muscular VSD, hypoplastic left ventricle and aortic arch, PDA, and suprasystemic RV pressure
EEG demonstrated frequent subclinical seizures
Ophthalmologic evaluation revealed bilateral optic nerve hypoplasia concerning for septo-optic dysplasia and left posterior polar cataract with microspherophakia
Postnatal brain MRI confirmed multifocal infarcts, polymicrogyria, corpus callosum dysgenesis, optic nerve hypoplasia, intraventricular septum defect, and inferior vermian hypoplasia
XomeDxXpress Clinical Exome Sequencing identified de novo heterozygous COL4A1 c.2771G>A variant
Postnatal renal ultrasound showed mild left calyceal dilatation with negative CMV workup

Clinical course demonstrated successful weaning to room air and oral feeds with discharge on cardiac medications (hydrochlorothiazide-spironolactone) and antiepileptics (phenobarbital, levetiracetam, lacosamide)
